name: Zemenawi CRM
summary: A CRM platform decomposed into independently deployable Spring Boot services, with its own gateway, service discovery, centralised configuration and log aggregation.

components.name: gateway-bff
components.description: Edge gateway and backend-for-frontend. Single entry point for clients, responsible for routing and request shaping.

components.name: discovery-server
components.description: Service registry, so services resolve each other by name rather than by hardcoded address.

components.name: config-server
components.description: Centralised configuration, keeping environment differences out of the service images.

components.name: auth-service-keycloak
components.description: Authentication and authorisation built on Keycloak, issuing tokens consumed by the other services.

components.name: notification-service
components.description: Handles outbound notifications independently of the request path that triggers them.

components.name: logmanager
components.description: Log aggregation across services, so a single request can be traced past a service boundary.

components.name: common-lib
components.description: Shared contracts and utilities, keeping cross-service types defined in one place.

name: Zemen Hub
summary: A TypeScript platform built alongside a dedicated backend service, developed over roughly a year.

name: API Gateway
summary: A standalone Java gateway service the routing and entry-point layer that sits in front of a set of backend services.

name: Container & Deployment Infrastructure
summary: Docker Compose and deployment configuration maintained as its own concern, separate from the applications it runs.

components.name: motomo_docker
components.description: Docker configuration for a self-hosted analytics deployment.

components.name: liteapp_dockercompose
components.description: Compose stack for a multi-container application.

components.name: backend-infra
components.description: Shared infrastructure definitions for backend services.

name: AI Product Engineering — Universal Perk
summary: Creva AI, Dasguzo and other AI-product SaaS tools, built end to end while working remotely for a Texas-based company.

components.name: alv-ai-backend
components.description: Backend service for AI-product features authentication, integrations and API surface.

components.name: creva-ai-dashboard
components.description: Dashboard interface for Creva AI, one of the SaaS products built and launched at Universal Perk.

components.name: PortaAI
components.description: AI application built alongside Creva AI and Dasguzo.

name: This Portfolio
summary: A statically generated Next.js site with a grounded AI assistant that answers questions from structured content rather than a scraped page.
